h1: Free On-Site Water Test and Consultation
directAnswer: AquaPure will test your water free of charge, at your property, at a time you choose. A technician measures TDS and hardness at your tap, explains what those readings mean for your specific situation, and leaves a fixed written quotation in AED. There is no call-out fee and no obligation, and the recommendation is sometimes that your existing system only needs a cartridge.
keyFacts: Free, on site, with no call-out fee and no obligation
TDS and hardness measured at your tap — not a figure quoted for your emirate
The reading is what determines whether you need RO, carbon, softening, disinfection or nothing
You leave with a written quotation in AED rather than a verbal figure
whatItIs: The water test is the step that turns a purchase into a decision. TDS tells you how much is dissolved in your water; hardness tells you how much of that is the calcium and magnesium behind limescale. Those two readings, taken at your tap, point to different technologies — and they differ between buildings, between risers in the same building, and before and after a tank has been cleaned.

That is why we do not publish a water-quality figure for any emirate, and why any recommendation made without a reading is a guess dressed as advice. The consultation is the reading plus the explanation: what it means for your property, what it does not mean, and which of the available options the number actually justifies.

whoNeedsIt.title: Anyone considering a purchase
whoNeedsIt.body: Ten minutes of measurement is the difference between buying RO for a chlorine complaint and buying the carbon stage that actually fixes it.

whoNeedsIt.title: People with an existing system and a new complaint
whoNeedsIt.body: A taste change, slower flow or returning scale. The reading usually identifies whether it is a cartridge, the membrane, or something else entirely.

whoNeedsIt.title: New tenants and owners
whoNeedsIt.body: You have inherited whatever the last occupant fitted. A test and inspection tells you what is there and whether it is working.

whoNeedsIt.title: Anyone who has been quoted for something large
whoNeedsIt.body: A second reading and a second opinion costs nothing here. If the recommendation you have been given is right, we will say so.

howItWorks.title: Book a slot
howItWorks.body: By phone or WhatsApp, at a time that suits you. Tell us the emirate and area so we can confirm the realistic window.

howItWorks.title: Measure at your tap
howItWorks.body: TDS and hardness, taken in front of you, from the outlet you actually use — and where relevant from more than one point in the property.

howItWorks.title: Explain the readings
howItWorks.body: What the numbers indicate, what they cannot tell you, and which complaints they do and do not explain. TDS in particular is a blunt instrument: it says how much is dissolved, not what.

howItWorks.title: Written quotation, no obligation
howItWorks.body: A fixed price in AED for whatever is recommended — or a clear statement that nothing is needed. Whether you proceed is entirely your decision.

benefits.title: You see your own numbers
benefits.body: Not an emirate average and not a figure from a website. The reading from your tap is the only one your system should be specified against.

benefits.title: It prevents the expensive mistake
benefits.body: Overspecifying is the most common way UAE households overspend on filtration. A reading is what tells you where to stop.

benefits.title: The 'you need nothing' outcome is real
benefits.body: If your existing system just needs a cartridge, that is what the visit concludes. It happens often enough to be worth saying.

benefits.title: Costs you nothing either way
benefits.body: No call-out fee, no obligation, no follow-up pressure.

maintenance.title: Retest when something changes
maintenance.body: After a tank clean, after a building changes its supply arrangement, or when a taste changes for no obvious reason.

maintenance.title: Retest at service visits
maintenance.body: Feed and treated readings at each service are how membrane condition is actually judged, rather than by date.

commonProblems.problem: A recommendation made without a reading
commonProblems.cause: Selling a package rather than diagnosing a property.
commonProblems.fix: Ask for the measured figures and where they were taken. Any specification should be traceable to a reading.

commonProblems.problem: TDS treated as a quality score
commonProblems.cause: It is the number most easily measured, so it gets over-interpreted.
commonProblems.fix: Understand it as a quantity, not an identity. A low TDS reading does not by itself mean the water is safe, and a high one does not by itself mean it is unsafe.

choosingFactors.title: Test before you shop, not after
choosingFactors.body: The reading narrows the options considerably, which makes every subsequent conversation shorter.

choosingFactors.title: Test at the outlet you use
choosingFactors.body: A reading from a garden tap or a bathroom tap can differ from the kitchen cold tap you drink from.

choosingFactors.title: Ask what the reading does not cover
choosingFactors.body: TDS and hardness do not identify specific contaminants. If you have a specific concern, laboratory analysis is the honest route, and we will say so rather than pretend a handheld meter answers it.

uaeContext: An on-site test matters more in the UAE than a national or emirate-level figure ever could, because the biggest variable is not the utility's output — it is what happens between the network and your tap. Building storage, riser age, tanker delivery and how long water has been standing all move the reading.

It is also why we decline to publish a TDS figure for Dubai, Abu Dhabi or anywhere else. Two apartments in the same tower can read differently. The number that should decide what you buy is the one measured where you drink.
pricingNote: The test and consultation are free, with no call-out fee and no obligation. Any work that follows is quoted in writing, in AED, before it begins.
metaDescription: Free on-site water test across the UAE. TDS and hardness measured at your own tap and explained, with a written quotation and no call-out fee.
